title: President
description: Head of State and Government of the Republic of Kenya as per Article 131.

title: Deputy President
description: Principal assistant to the President as per Article 147.

title: Cabinet Secretary
description: Member of the Cabinet responsible for a specific ministry as per Article 152.

title: Attorney General
description: Principal legal adviser to the Government as per Article 156.

title: Speaker of the National Assembly
description: Presiding officer of the National Assembly as per Article 106.

title: Speaker of the Senate
description: Presiding officer of the Senate as per Article 106.

title: Chief Justice
description: Head of the Judiciary and President of the Supreme Court as per Article 161.

title: Judge of the Supreme Court
description: Member of the highest court in Kenya as per Article 163.

title: Governor
description: Chief Executive of a County Government as per Article 179.

title: Deputy Governor
description: Assistant to the County Governor as per Article 180.

title: Member of Parliament
description: Elected representative of a constituency as per Article 97.

title: Senator
description: Representative of a county in the Senate as per Article 98.
